children.game_version: A freeze-dance game where children twist freely to rock and roll music and freeze when the music stops.

seniors.counts: 4/4 steady counts at a slow, controlled pace.
seniors.seated_version: Perform the hip swivel and arm movements while seated firmly in a chair.
seniors.standing_version: Stand holding onto a sturdy chair or rail for balance while executing gentle weight shifts on the feet.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo and minimized range of hip and foot rotation.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Held out from the body and bent at the elbow, staying relatively stationary or thrusting in coordination with hip movement.
movement_profile.footwork: Feet remain in contact with the floor on the balls of the feet, grinding back and forth as if putting out a cigarette.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: No-contact solo dancing requiring minimal space, performed individually, in rows, or in a crowd.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Hips, torso, and legs rotate as a single unit, swiveling from side to side erotically.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Low level with very little vertical motion; occasional single leg lifts for styling.
movement_profile.partnering: None; dancers do not touch each other.
movement_profile.posture: Low posture with knees bent slightly, torso squared or angled.

signature_moves.description: Grinding the balls of the feet back and forth on the floor as if extinguishing a cigarette.
signature_moves.name: Cigarette Stomp

signature_moves.description: Swiveling hips from side to side as if rubbing oneself with a towel.
signature_moves.name: Towel Wipe

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Fast and rhythmic, matching upbeat rock and roll tempos.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Partner contact and high vertical jumps.

music_profile.musical_form: Verse-chorus rock and roll song structure
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Rock and roll beat with a strong backbeat
music_profile.sound_description: An energetic rock and roll track featuring a driving drum backbeat, prominent electric guitars, and celebratory vocals commanding dancers to twist.
music_profile.vocal_style: Enthusiastic vernacular pop and R&B vocals

basic_steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent and arms bent at the elbows.
Rotate hips, torso, and legs on the balls of the feet as a single unit.
Grind feet back and forth on the floor as if putting out a cigarette.
Sway upper body forward and backward while swiveling hips from side to side.
teaching.formation: Solo, in rows, or in a crowded group without partner contact
teaching.level_notes: Accessible to all levels due to the absence of complex footwork or partner connection.
